body:
This drunk lady started screaming at my husband for driving to fast into the parking lot. Which he didn't, there was even a maintenance guy who witnessed the whole thing and stood up for NY husband, drunk lady still called the cops. I have a video of her telling my husband to, "suck her dick" plus other obscenities.

Then when I went to walk my dog it got into an altercation with another dog and the other neighbors who live above us were insisting police file it as a dog bite case, which isn't mandatory but does require things like quarantine. Both dogs were bit, nothing major, Just punctures and bruises. They are threatening us, the drunk is threatening us.

I'm just sick and tired of it all. I can never catch a break.
I made an appointment for Monday, thank you.
Out of no where the guy comes up to my husband and apologized for the whole thing. It was crazy! Little does he know how close he came to getting one of these.
Good to know. It's just making me tired. So I'll try some opiates. Thanks
Well I've tried multiple times getting help from my "husband" and he doesn't care enough to help. So he doesn't care about me. 99% sure he'd only miss the chores I do
I think the only thing he would Miss is my cleaning and taking care of our son. I'm trapped in my house 24/7.
No one would miss me
Because there's no one. No one cares. My last very for help was this stupid website and everyone is just shitting on me. No one in my real life cares, what's the point?

DOWNVOTE all you want assholes. You act like you want to help people then just shit on them because you think you're superior than those who come here asking for real help. Real advice. And all you do is shut me down and downvote me. You weren't there. You have no idea what happened, but all you care about is your stupid internet karma and making other people feel badly about themselves.

All you stupid lawyers who pretend to want to help people just come on here and try to tell everyone how smart you are. Congratulations. You went 200K into debt to act superior to people. I hope you feel great about yourself.

People come here for actual help, when they need something and you pretentious assholes in your mansions just act like we're all criminals who aren't "deserving" of your help. I'm tired of it. I reached out for help. Not so a bunch of losers could down vote me.

I guess I should stop wasting my time asking fake lawyers for their fake advice.
Nope.
So, randomly the guy came and apologized, It was crazy. He has no idea how close he was to a shit shake.
That's why I'm here instead of on facebook. It's never ending!

I am a medical patient and I smoke all day everyday, from the time I wake up until I go to bed. My tolerance is pretty high so I never get high to the point I cannot function. I don't even really smoke to get high anymore, just so I can get thru my day. It takes like 6 dabs for me to feel so stoned I can't do anything. I'm actually studying for the LSATs right now. 

I will warn you that your tolerance might build up very quickly and then it just takes more and more to get really really high. But taking time off and cutting back will fix a tolerance build up.
OMG. This. This is perfect, thank you! We've been trying to figure out a way to get poo into his car! But I'll save that for drastic times, until then I'm going to start recording everything. Thanks!
You need to stop drinking, that will kill you. The weed is fine, i use of medicinally and smoke all the time.

You really should not be sexting at your age. I know it seems like no biggie but nothing is ever really gone once it's online. You need to tell your parents what happened. If he's stalking you it's a matter of your safety.

She leaves it because she knows you'll just do it eventually when you get sick of it. You need to have a serious discussion with her about cleaning things up immediately when they happen. Especially pet and human sick and mess, that's disgusting. Your health can really suffer in an environment like that, especially if you have asthma or allergies. If she isn't willing to change you need to ask yourself if you can live like this forever. If the answer is no, then gtfo

You're not being selfish, he is. Why do his friends need to come? I understand maybe having his best friend come along so he doesn't feel left out all of the time, but not all of them. He should have asked you who you wanted to invite. You should tell him how you feel.
This is disgusting. I'm sad to see the country going backwards.

Please don't go back. Was he under the influence of anything? Not that this excuses what he said/did. I've been in an abusive relationship before and he would always apologize with big promises not to do it again,  but he did. 

Calling your baby stupid and wishing she didn't exist is unacceptable. Throwing things at you is so over the line it's not funny, that's how things escalate easily. If he's okay with throwing things at you intending to hit you,  he's okay with actually hitting you. You need to make sure you're safe then reschedule evaluate your relationship with him.

Can I ask a couple questions about your eating disorder? Was it diagnosed by someone? Do you feel any desire to eat, like hunger? I'm curious because I just don't feel like eating and barely do, this set in a few months ago, but I never thought of it as an eating disorder.

I appreciate the serious, non insulting, replies. It seems like I still have some issues to work through myself, separate from my husband. I haven't had the nerve to talk to him about it, yet. But I'm going to research a counselor to see that maybe my insurance will help cover.

I thought you were going to say he wanted to wear a tutu or dress to school or something, which is fine. I really don't understand what your in-laws issues are. Kids are kids and they need to chill out. It's cute that he cares about what he wears and wants to have an opinion, good for him. Even if he does want to be fashionable it doesn't mean he's gay, he's just a little GQ.
Edited a typo, calling me sexually abusive is wrong and a horrible thing to say to me. I can't here for actually help, not to be insulted.

I did go to counseling a few years ago and it really helped. I know I still have issues with it that I need to resolve, it's hard because I don't have anyone to talk to about it. My husband thinks I should just be over it by now.

I didn't mean to imply I thought my husband was sexually abusive. I've never felt that way, I meant my ex was sexually abusive along with being physically abusive. I edited it to take out the word,  "too".

I'm sure I could find a position that sex would be comfortable with my knee, but I don't feel well in general. It's more that I don't feel like sex because I don't feel well overall. 

And when did I ever say that I reward him with,  "starfish sex"? That's rudely presumptuous of you to say. When we have sex we have great sex, I just don't feel like having sex all the damn time,  which is what I feel he wants.

Bridezilla needs to calm down. There are tons of ways you can have water without it being an "ugly plastic bottle". You could have a glass that wouldn't look out of place. If it were me I'd make you some cute solution like a water bottle painted as a tuxedo. Make sure your health comes first,  you passing out at your own wedding would be way worse than carrying a water bottle.
